GALIGAMUWA PRADESHIYA SABHA

I hereby give notice for information of General Public that as per Secretary’s Decision No. 2025/10/ඊ-16 of. General Meeting held on 08 th October,2025, roads and paths included in this Schedule should be declared as roads and paths belonged to Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha in terms of task assigned to Pradeshiya Sabhas in Sabaragamuwa Province, having extended time by the series of orders with regard to publishing notices indicating register and caused to be prepared plans for roads and paths maintained by Sabaragamuwa Province having been declared in Extraordinary Gazette Notiﬁ cation No. 2316/20 and dated 24th of January ,2023 by Hon. Governor in Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council read as Section 24 of Pradeshiya sabha Act. No. 15 of 1987 .

If opinion of party claiming to a land that any road or a path included in the said Schedule is inclusive in any partition of land, I hereby notify those legal actions should be taken to institute an action in the competent court before expiration of a period of three months from this Notice to prove his right for the said land

Further, I notify that every road and path included in the said Schedule which hasn’t been instituted a legal action before expiration of the said period of three months should be deemed to be a road or a path belonged to Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha.
R.L Rajapaksha,Chairman, Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha.At Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha , Pitagaldeniya,On 23th October 2025.
